notes.title: Elroy and the Aliens (PC) Review
notes.notes:
I’ve said it before, but surprises like Elroy and the Aliens are why I still enjoy being a video game critic. I try to stay as on top of interesting and fun-looking games as I can, but I’m only one man, and I can’t know everything. So when an opportunity slides across my desk to review something I’ve heard basically nothing about, it’s always an exciting venture to be surprised—for better or worse.

Elroy and the Aliens is a great game. An old-school point-and-click adventure bolstered by an interesting story and a ton of heart. In a way, it almost feels unbelievable—in this current videogame landscape, you shouldn’t be able to make something like this, let alone have it be half this good. Just more reason to keep an eye on the indie scene. 

The story begins when the titular Elroy meets with a journalist named Peggy Wolfe to show her his new prototype rocket built for commercial travel. However, during the demonstration, a strange electrical discharge causes the rocket... Read more

notes.title: Behind the Scenes: Crafting Elroy's Art and Animation
notes.notes:
Hey Friends! 👋

Urban, our man responsible for all the visual juiciness in Elroy and the Aliens (a.k.a. Art Director), is sharing a bit of the vision and challenges behind the game's colorful and vibrant cartoony art style.

[previewyoutube=lC_Mz1OSDO4;full][/previewyoutube]

We always wanted the game to feel like you're [b]playing your favorite childhood cartoon or adventure movie.[/b] 🎬 We started searching for inspiration in classics from the '80s and '90s, an era very close to us.

From a visual perspective, we’ve always been in love with LucasArts games, Hanna-Barbera cartoons, Spielberg movies, Disney classics, and so many other creations that trigger that special magical tingling — the one you got as a kid when you sat down in the living room on a Saturday morning and started watching your favorite cartoon. ✨

Speaking of inspiration, here’s some suuuuper early concept art of Elroy! It's taken from [i]The Art of Elroy and the Aliens[/i], a making-of book that we'll release later this year.

Urban got his first inspiration for Elroy's look from Disney's short film Paperman. Read more about it in the excerpt below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/ccacfb35efa2f1999854cdbf44ef2b8ff47103ec.png[/img]

Fast forward about 11 years... and here we are today! Just [b]13 days before the launch of the game on April 2nd![/b] 🚀

We are so incredibly grateful to all of you who have supported Elroy and stuck with us through all these years. ❤️

notes.title: Play Elroy's Top Rated Demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey Friends! Time to [b]play the Demo on Steam Next Fest[/b] (Feb/24th - Mar/3rd) starting today!
Thank you so much for all your overwhelmingly amazing reviews so far! 😍

[h2]What's in the Demo? [/h2]

Here's a little side-questy sneak peek! :) 

[previewyoutube=v9gjmnh4QlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Game Features[/h2]

🎭 A [b]story-driven[/b] point-and-click adventure game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities, and an ancient archaeological mystery.

🎨 High-resolution, [b]hand-drawn 2D[/b] art and animations with an [b]old-school vibe[/b] and [b]modern polish[/b].

🔊 [b]Fully-voiced[/b] characters by A-list actors in English (such as Jay Rincon, Dev Joshi and many others) and an [b]original music[/b] score (composed by Martin Bezjak and Epix Soundworks) for an immersive [b]movie-like experience[/b].

🧩 Intriguing and challenging [b]puzzles[/b].

🪐 Spanning [b]2 planets[/b], [b]60 locations[/b], and featuring more than [b]60 characters[/b].

👥 [b]Multiple[/b] playable characters.

📝 [b]Subtitles[/b] in German (by Marcel Weyers), Spanish (by Concha Fernández Álvarez), French (by Christophe Pallarès), Portuguese-Brasil (by Rômulo Wehling) and English as the original language.

[h2]The Game's Mission[/h2]

Why did we start hand-crafting Elroy 11 years ago? We wanted to revive that special feeling that happens only once, when you're a kid. When the eyes are wide open and full of wonder. When you're sitting in the living room on a Saturday morning and play THAT game on your parents' PC for the first time.  🤩

[h2]Demo Feedback[/h2]

If you'd like to share your thoughts or feedback on the Demo with us, we have a nifty Steam Forum thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1082190/discussions/0/598519418380617113/]right here[/url] for you. Also, we'll keep the Demo live after Next Fest so you can try it when it suits you.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

The countdown has begun! Elroy and the Aliens is launching 37 days from today, on [b]April 2nd, 2025! [/b]🚀

You've been suggesting and we've been listening! 🙌 We've been making improvements all along to make Elroy the best point & click adventure game we can. The game is now 99.9908% complete! We will keep polishing the cutlery to be 100% ready when we invite you to dig in and get the game fresh and hot on it's release on April 2nd!   

You'd like to keep in touch with us? [b]Follow Elroy on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elroythegame.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/ElroyTheGame]X[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wmmDgwAust]Discord[/url][/b]! We love to chat.

notes.title: Ghost Town Time Lapse
notes.notes:
Hey, friends!

It's no secret that we're huge fans of the old-school drawing and animation style from legends like Mr. Chuck Jones, Hanna-Barbera, & Co. They brought the timeless magic of Saturday morning cartoons into our living rooms, making us smile and feel cozy and warm. The vibrant colors, the contrasts, the tiny irregularities of the hand-drawn line and the perfection of it at the same time — what a treat!

From the start, when we began creating Elroy about 10 years ago, we made a decision. We want both you and ourselves to experience that same feeling of warmth and coziness we had back in the '80s and '90s watching those marvelous hand-drawn cartoons, through Elroy's art as well. There should be no compromise, no cutting corners.

Using modern tools, all of the art in Elroy and the Aliens is carefully drawn by hand, ensuring that all the colors, shadows, and lines are just right, exactly where they're supposed to be.

So, how do we do it? Here's a little time-lapse of a desert ghost town named Losantos coming to life. 
And make sure to turn on the sound, too! ;)

[previewyoutube=InruJ64ysRQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Until next time, folks! 
Team Elroy

-----

notes.title: Lift Off: How to Build an Interstellar Vessel at Home
notes.notes:
Heyo, folks! 

With engineers having a knack for finding and building solutions to complex problems, they rely on various tools and tactics to complete the task at hand. This one seems to be plug-and-play, though. :) 

In this sneak peek, we catch a glimpse of Elroy as he navigates his home, picks up a propulsion module, climbs the stairs to his rooftop and, as engineers do, installs it in his DIY rocket.  

This video is a short example of how we strive to orchestrate the voice, art and sound of Elroy to make the characters and environments of Elroy and the Aliens as lively as the old-school Saturday morning cartoons we used to love as kids .. and still do as mature and responsible old farts.
